title: Nice app
body:
Update // After 2 years -and some changes in the economy of my country- I finally can afford the payment and believe me, the app has improved a lot in a good meaning. I’m really happy with the app and its design ux/ui and how fluid it works. Thank you a lots! 100/100! 🌸🩷

—
Beautiful app with really usefull options. It's limitated in the free version but still you can test it. I liked the challenges section (not invasive) and the sync. I wish I could purchase it but, even at the 50% off, the full lifetime version is still too expensive for my region (and the montly payment is not an option with a coin deprecated each day). But if you can, give it a chance, you will enjoy the app!

title: Really great app!
body:
I think it’s a great app, very friendly UI and very useful. I think it still has some room for improvement in reporting, adding notes (currently notes are logged with the current date and you can’t modify it) and some other details, but overall is the best tracking app I’ve tried, at an affordable price.
Very excited to see what’s the future of the product!
